title_en: Fifth Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture, 2026 (Online)
summary: University researchers who wish to attend the Central Library's fifth researcher career mentoring lecture of 2026 must register online in advance. The lecture is held online on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00. The notice text does not give the registration link, the registration deadline or the access link.
applies_to: Researchers at the university (학내 연구자). Attendance is voluntary, but anyone who wishes to attend must register online in advance.

dates.what: Online lecture (for all who have registered in advance)

conditions: Online advance registration is mandatory to attend.
The notice text does not state a registration deadline, a registration link or how to join the online session.
steps: Register online in advance; the notice text does not give the registration link or method, so check the original notice or contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Join the online lecture on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, at 14:00.
translation:
Notice: The 5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture of 2026

To enhance the research capabilities of researchers at the university and to support paper writing, the Central Library will hold a special lecture as follows. We encourage your interest and participation.

A. Title: [Online] The 5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture of 2026

B. Date and time: Wednesday, 21 October 2026, 14:00–15:00

C. Content: Tips for publishing papers and Open Access, from an IEEE editor
- Guidance on the IEEE paper submission and review process
- Good practices and tips for increasing the likelihood of publication (focusing mainly on Seoul National University cases)
- IEEE author guidelines on the use of AI-generated text
- Benefits of IEEE Open Access publishing and information on institutional programs
- Research strategies using the IEEE Xplore Digital Library

E. Speaker: an IEEE APAC Client Services Manager (the name is given in the original notice)

F. How to participate: Attend after completing online advance registration (mandatory).

(Note: The original notice skips item D. The notice text does not include the registration link or the link for joining the online session.)
